title: Bledsoe told that rockets fail because they carry weapons

tellings.quote: and he asked uh are there weapons on them? And they said yeah and he goes that's why that's why it's not working. They don't want it to work.
That's what I'm saying. Every time they send one up, it attracts them and they'll come up and look at it if it has weapons on board.
tellings.difference: Credits Timothy Taylor and says the UFOs come up to look at every weapon-carrying launch, where the story says they make the rockets fail.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Bledsoe's account linking UFOs to rockets that carry weapons on board, with the weapons as what draws the UFOs' attention.

as_told.title: UFOs come to inspect rockets carrying weapons

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs show up around him, was reportedly told around 2007 that rocket launches go wrong because they carry weapons. The YouTuber Chris Ramsay tells it from Bledsoe: someone asked whether there were weapons on the rockets, was told yes, and answered that this is why they fail, because 'they' do not want them to work. Bledsoe tells it himself in 2026 a little differently, crediting a man named Timothy Taylor and saying that every weapon-carrying launch draws the craft up to look at it.
